contract: Lemma 4.4: under adaptive covariate selection (X_t F_{t-1}-measurable) and randomized bounded assignment (p_t in [fmin,fmax]), the IPW pseudo-outcome is unbiased: E[Y~_t|X_t,p_t,F_{t-1}] = tau(X_t).
control: Negative control: when randomization is VIOLATED (T correlated with Y(1) potential), the pseudo-outcome becomes biased (grand bias 0.0666), confirming randomization -- not selection -- is what protects unbiasedness.
notes: Adaptive policy selects the LEAST-sampled segment each round (depends on past selections -> F_{t-1}-measurable). This is the condition Lemma 4.4 addresses and the prior toy repro omitted (it used i.i.d. Bern(0.5) X).
